description: Automerge every update, majors included, once the required CI checks pass (GitHub native auto-merge). The app's libraries are bumped in libs.versions.toml (the catalog maven_kmp reads), the build tools' maven.install artifacts and the Bazel modules in MODULE.bazel; renovate-pins.yml then re-pins the lockfiles on the PR's branch (bazel/renovate/repin.sh)

packageRules.description: kotlinx-datetime publishes '-0.6.x-compat' sibling releases; they are not upgrades

Kotlin and what's built for one Kotlin release move together: Kotlin's plugins (the Compose compiler among them), rules_kotlin (it bundles the compiler Bazel runs, which must equal the catalog's kotlin), and the Metro and Mappie compiler plugins. Split groups open PRs that each fail alone
AGP and the lint it runs release together (lint's version is AGP's + 23): @android_tools' AGP and builder, android_sdk.agp (aapt2) and @android_lint's lint-gradle move as one
@proguard applies the Compose Gradle plugin's default ProGuard rules for the Compose libraries the catalog pins, so the plugin moves with them

customManagers.description: The Go SDK rules_go downloads for the Gazelle extension (MODULE.bazel's go_sdk.download)
The AGP release aapt2 is downloaded from (MODULE.bazel's android_sdk.agp)
